summary:
{
  "ledger": [
    "Paneled door at scene left | partly visible left of the man and coat-bearing door | fills the left half as the man approaches it | leftward camera pan reveals its panels, trim and low brass knob; the man remains in front of its surface",
    "Coat-bearing wooden door | behind the man, with a hook and hanging coat to the left of a framed print | behind and to the right of the man | shifts toward screen right during the leftward pan; hook, print and paneling retain their relative positions",
    "Hanging coat and hook | against the wooden door behind the man's left shoulder | visible to the man's right on the same door | the man passes in front of the coat; previously covered portions become visible without reversed depth ordering",
    "Framed print on coat-bearing door | partly occluded by the man's head and torso, right of the coat | cropped at the right image edge | progressively revealed as the man moves left, then carried toward the edge by the camera pan",
    "Right-side green wall strip and adjacent wood panel | to the right of the coat-bearing door, with a small rectangular fixture and another framed picture farther right | outside the view | leave the frame consistently as the camera pans left",
    "Left-side green wall strip and fixtures | outside the initial crop, beyond the left door jamb | visible along the left edge with vertically arranged fixtures and plates | enter the view as the pan exposes the wall to the left of the approached door",
    "Man's spatial position | standing in front of the coat-bearing door and obscuring part of its print | standing close to the neighboring door on the left | moves left across the foreground; head, torso and raised hands consistently occlude the wooden surfaces behind them",
    "Camera and visible connectivity | medium frontal view of adjoining wooden surfaces and trim | left-shifted view following the man to the neighboring door | continuous pan preserves the left-to-right ordering of fixed elements; no doorway opens or reveals a connecting room"
  ],
  "findings": []
}
